email.subject: Quick fix for Redline Auto Care's site
email.body:
Hi Priya,

I looked at Redline Auto Care's website. Two things are likely costing you customers: it isn't optimized for mobile, and the photos are huge (9-14MB each), so pages load slowly - especially on phone data, which is how most people search for a mechanic nearby. Between those two, visitors are probably leaving before they see your reviews or hit "Book online."

Also, the footer still shows 2022, which can make people wonder if you're still open.

I fix this kind of thing for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough of what I found and what I'd change?

Alex
